result.summary: Found 3 issues: two major layout/content truncation problems and one minor duplicate content issue.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' section ('Smash Bros Bu...') is cut off at the right edge, truncating both the image and the restaurant name text.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontal scroll container shows a proper peek of the next card or adjust card sizing so partial cards are clearly indicated as scrollable, and the name should not be clipped without ellipsis.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Smash Bros Bu...' is truncated mid-word without an ellipsis, making it unclear what the full name is.
issues.suggestion: Apply CSS text-overflow: ellipsis or ensure the card width is sufficient to show the full name or a properly truncated version with '...'.

issues.description: Two identical 'Green Bowl Poké' restaurant cards with the same delivery time (15–25 min) and price (€0.90) appear side by side in the 'Fastest near you' section, which looks like a data duplication error.
issues.suggestion: Verify the data source to ensure distinct restaurant entries are being displayed. If these are two separate locations, differentiate them with location or branch identifiers.
